[[File:Pistol_Targeting_Optics.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Canderous Ordo]] wearing pistol targeting optics]]
'''Pistol targeting optics''' were an advanced optics and targeting system that was worn as a mask. This assemblage attached to a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistol]] and provided the weapon's wielder with information such as targeting information, distances, and the tracking of potential targets.

*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
